description_en: Calls a published Creative Agent with support for Lite and Dedicated editions, and returns execution progress and image artifacts by using Server-Sent Events (SSE). The Lite edition performs text-to-image or image-to-image generation depending on whether a reference image is provided. The Dedicated edition uses a Planner to plan and execute generation and editing tasks with multi-turn conversation support. Pass generation count, dimensions, and other parameters through metadata.parameters. Image URLs are included in the artifacts of the result
description_zh: 调用已发布的 Creative Agent，支持轻量版和专属版，以 SSE 返回执行进度和图片制品。轻量版根据是否提供参考图执行文生图或图生图；专属版通过 Planner 规划并执行生成、编辑任务，支持多轮会话。生成数量、尺寸等通过 metadata.parameters 传入，结果中的图片地址见 artifacts
name: AigcChatCompletionStream

parameters.help_en: The instance access key. The key must belong to the Creative Agent instance being called. This key is different from the AccessKey Secret used for OpenAPI signing. Do not expose it publicly
parameters.help_zh: 实例访问密钥，必须属于本次调用的 Creative Agent 实例。此密钥不同于用于 OpenAPI 签名的 AccessKey Secret，请勿公开
parameters.name: x_qi_agent_api_key

parameters.help_en: The published Creative Agent instance ID. Must correspond to the X-QI-Agent-Api-Key
parameters.help_zh: 已发布的 Creative Agent 实例 ID。必须与 X-QI-Agent-Api-Key 对应
parameters.name: x_qi_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The session identifier. Can be omitted for the first turn. Obtain it from the qi_session_id field in the SSE response and pass it back in subsequent turns. Use no more than 128 characters consisting of letters, digits, periods, underscores, colons, or hyphens
parameters.help_zh: 会话标识。首轮可省略；从 SSE 的 qi_session_id 获取并在后续轮次回传。请使用不超过 128 字符的字母、数字、点、下划线、冒号或连字符
parameters.name: x_qi_session_id

fields.help_en: The publicly accessible HTTPS URL of the reference image, or a complete Base64 image Data URL (such as data:image/png;base64,...). Signed URLs must remain valid during request execution. Re-upload or update the link for expired or unauthorized images
fields.help_zh: 参考图片的公开可访问 HTTPS 地址，或完整的 Base64 图片 Data URL（如 data:image/png;base64,...）。签名 URL 必须在请求执行期间有效；过期或无权限的图片需重新上传或更新链接
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The reference image when type is set to image_url. Supports HTTPS URLs or Base64 Data URLs
fields.help_zh: type=image_url 时的参考图。支持 HTTPS URL 或 Base64 Data URL
fields.name: image_url

fields.example: 把参考图背景改成海边日落
fields.help_en: The generation or editing objective when type is set to text
fields.help_zh: type=text 时的生成或编辑目标
fields.name: text

fields.help_en: The content part type: text, image_url, or video_url
fields.help_zh: 内容分片类型：text、image_url 或 video_url
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The video input when type is set to video_url. Only accepted by the Creative Agent Dedicated edition Planner. The Creative Agent Lite edition rejects this type
fields.help_zh: type=video_url 时的视频输入；仅 Creative Agent 专属版 Planner 接受，Creative Agent 轻量版 会拒绝
fields.name: video_url

fields.example: 生成一张雨后未来城市夜景
fields.help_en: The message content. Can be text. A multimodal array can contain text, image_url, or video_url. The Creative Agent Lite edition performs image-to-image when a reference image is provided and text-to-image when no reference image is provided. It does not accept video
fields.help_zh: 消息内容。可传文本；多模态数组可含 text、image_url 或 video_url。Creative Agent 轻量版 有参考图时走图生图、无参考图时走文生图，且不接受视频
fields.name: content

fields.help_en: The message role. Place the current generation objective in a user message. History can include user, assistant, and tool
fields.help_zh: 消息角色。当前生成目标放在 user 消息中；历史可包含 user、assistant、tool
fields.name: role

parameters.help_en: The conversation message array. Creative Agent uses the last user message as the current objective and executes it in combination with the session history
parameters.help_zh: 对话消息数组。Creative Agent 取最后一条 user 消息作为当前目标，并结合会话历史执行
parameters.name: messages

fields.help_en: The guidance scale. Must be a finite number between 0 and 20
fields.help_zh: 引导强度，必须是 0 到 20 的有限数值
fields.name: guidance_scale

fields.help_en: The number of images to generate for this request. Must be an integer in the range of 1 to 6
fields.help_zh: 本次请求生成图片张数，必须为整数且范围为 1 到 6
fields.name: n

fields.help_en: The negative prompt that describes content you do not want to appear in the result
fields.help_zh: 负向提示词，用于描述不希望出现在结果中的内容
fields.name: negative_prompt

fields.help_en: The number of model inference iterations. Must be an integer in the range of 1 to 200
fields.help_zh: 模型推理迭代次数，必须为整数且范围为 1 到 200
fields.name: num_inference_steps

fields.help_en: The random seed. Must be an integer in the range of 0 to 2147483647
fields.help_zh: 随机种子，必须为整数且范围为 0 到 2147483647
fields.name: seed

fields.help_en: The output pixel dimensions, such as `1024*1024` or `1280*720`. The format `1024x1024` is also accepted. When specified, this value overrides the default canvas dimensions for this request. Use width and height values supported by the model
fields.help_zh: 输出像素尺寸，例如 `1024*1024`、`1280*720`，也接受 `1024x1024`。填写后覆盖本次默认画幅尺寸；请使用模型支持的宽高
fields.name: size

fields.help_en: The image parameters for this request. Only size, n, seed, negative_prompt, num_inference_steps, and guidance_scale are supported. Omitted fields use the default configurations. response_format is not supported
fields.help_zh: 本次图片参数。只支持 size、n、seed、negative_prompt、num_inference_steps、guidance_scale；省略的字段沿用默认配置。不支持 response_format
fields.name: parameters

parameters.help_en: The extended input for this image creation request. Use the parameters object to set generation parameters. Do not use this field to pass model addresses or keys
parameters.help_zh: 本次图片创作的扩展输入。使用 parameters 对象设置生成参数，不用于传递模型地址或密钥
parameters.name: metadata

parameters.help_en: A compatibility placeholder field. Can be omitted or set to an empty string. You cannot use this field to switch the model used by the instance. The model field in the response is an empty string
parameters.help_zh: 兼容占位字段，可省略或传空字符串。不能通过此字段切换实例使用的模型，响应中的 model 为空字符串
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use SSE streaming responses. This parameter must be set to true for this operation
parameters.help_zh: 是否使用 SSE 流式响应。本接口必须传 true
parameters.name: stream

fields.help_en: The HTTP JSON key is include_usage. When set to true, an independent usage chunk is returned before the end marker. The choices field in this chunk is an empty array. Token usage does not represent the number of images or the final bill
fields.help_zh: HTTP JSON 键为 include_usage。为 true 时，在结束标记之前返回独立用量块；其 choices 为空数组。Token 用量不代表图片张数或最终账单
fields.name: include_usage

parameters.help_en: The HTTP JSON key is stream_options. Set include_usage to retrieve the token usage for this call
parameters.help_zh: HTTP JSON 键为 stream_options。设置 include_usage 以获取本次调用的 Token 用量
parameters.name: stream_options

schema.description_en: The SSE streaming response metadata. Business data is returned continuously as chat.completion.chunk events and ends with data:[DONE]. For complete field descriptions, see the response parameter supplementary notes
schema.description_zh: SSE 流式响应元数据。业务数据按 chat.completion.chunk 事件连续返回，最终以 data:[DONE] 结束；完整字段说明见返回参数补充说明

requestId.description_en: The request identity generated by the POP gateway for gateway tracing. The Agent execution request ID is the qi_request_id in the SSE body
requestId.description_zh: 由 POP 网关生成的请求标识，用于网关链路追踪；Agent 执行请求 ID 以 SSE 正文中的 qi_request_id 为准

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request JSON object that contains conversation messages and stream. Image generation parameters are placed in metadata.parameters. See the request examples below
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求 JSON 对象，包含对话 messages 和 stream；图片生成参数放在 metadata.parameters。请求示例见下方
v1_body_parameters.name: body
